svg.title: SIGILIV · SCHOLAE · SCIETIAR · STVD · GEN · CIVIT · CAESARAVG
svg.desc: Historical emblem of the Faculty of Sciences, University of Zaragoza, in use since January 1923: an ouroboros over the city wall, flanked by the arms of Zaragoza and of the Kingdom of Aragon. The legend expands to SIGILLVM SCHOLAE SCIENTIARVM STVDII GENERALIS CIVITATIS CAESARAVGVSTANAE; the forms SCIETIAR and SIGILIV reflect the loss of the nasal macron and a later transcription slip (Bernues & Randez, conCIENCIAS 10, 2012, 108-113). Vectorised from a low-resolution scan.
